text.content:
The people who made the neuroport.

Headquarters: Rocklin Augmentics (#16), Charter Hill
Industry: Cybernetics and cyberware manufacturing
Leadership: Jacinda Hidalgo, CEO
Known for: The neuroport, the central operating system nearly all cyberware now runs through

An American cybernetics company. Its CEO, Jacinda Hidalgo, is a committed transhumanist who pushed her engineers to imagine one mind running many bodies. That dream didn't work, but the central control system it needed did: the neuroport, which bigger corps soon copied.

Neuroports were cheap, safe and everywhere by the late 2050s: ID, wallet, holophone and HUD in one implant. In Night City, Rocklin's prototype clinic in Charter Hill is the only one on the hill that takes walk-ins, and Rocklin is one of the three campus corps in the Charter Hill security consortium.

GM secrets

The first neuroports were sold in 2048. A year earlier, thousands of Roxanne Lawrence's fans had been fitted with free prototype Neuroports that let something puppet them on Static Night. Nobody has ever admitted to making those. Lyle Thompson has held one next to a 2048 model, and runners who have made the same comparison won't discuss it on the CitiNet.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.8; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05, 06
